# Example outputs (generated by `python smoke_test.py`)

After a successful agent run, WarungFlow writes (gitignored at commit time except this file):

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `daily_report.md` | Ringkasan harian kasflow dan rekonsiliasi |
| `payment_reminders.md` | Pesan penagihan Bahasa Indonesia |
| `financing_readiness.md` | Snapshot kesiapan pembiayaan |
| `validation_report.md` | Hasil validasi kelengkapan output |
| `reconciliation_result.csv` | Status per order (PAID, UNPAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, OVERPAID, NEEDS_REVIEW) |
| `execution_trace.csv` | Jejak tool call otonom (untuk juri) |

Run locally:

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
python smoke_test.py -v
```

The Streamlit **Beranda** and **Laporan** pages also offer the same exports as downloadable files after each run.
